reason:
Reproduced on Linux x86_64 with installed uv 0.12.13 and Python 3.12.3. Using a dependency-free local PEP 517 backend, ran `uv --no-config --offline --cache-dir "$case/cache" build --wheel --python /usr/bin/python3 "$case/source"`. After SIGKILL to only uv, plain `uv --cache-dir "$case/cache" cache clean` succeeded while the backend remained alive. Its environment disappeared, its next write failed with ENOENT, and an environment-local import raised ModuleNotFoundError. Cleanup correctly waited while uv was alive.

Also reproduced without signals: `uv pip install --no-deps "$case/slow" "$case/fail"` with build concurrency two exited after one backend failed, removing the surviving backend’s environment and causing the same errors. Plain prune retained the environment on this older version; the reported newer prune revision and macOS setup were not runtime-tested.

The requested README update failed because its filesystem is read-only. The revised handoff and reproduction artifacts are saved under /tmp/uv-22338-repro-WHzslA/, including README.md. The checkout and GitHub were unchanged.
